sourceTitle: Heart Shaped Jelly For Valentine's Day
sourceText:
Heart Shaped Jelly For Valentine's Day
By: Anncoo
Published: Sunday, February 13, 2011 - 11:33pm

Ingredients




5 inches Prepare one 6 heart shaped," heart shaped mold and 3- 4 trays of small heart shaped& rose mold
400 milliliters Water
100 milliliters Fresh milk
85 grams Sugar
6 grams Agar agar powder
1 pandan leaf, wash and clean then tie pandan leaf into a small knot
2 Put all ingredients except fresh milk into a pot and keep stirring agar agar liq
Pour some agar agar liquid into a measuring cup and add a drop of pink coloring into it, mix well then p
20 Put small trays to set in fridge for about minutes and remove small hearts and roses from mold
5 inches Now prepare agar agar liquid for inches and 6 heart shaped mold
550 milliliters Water
95 grams Sugar
7 grams Agar agar powder
1 Pandan leaf, wash and clean then tie pandan leaf into a small knot

Preparation

1 Put everything into pot and keep stirring agar agar liquid to boil at medium heat. Off heat, discard leaf and continue to stir agar agar liquid for another 2 minutes. 2 Then pour some agar agar liquid into molds about half inches high, wait for a while till liquid to semi-set, using a small knife to scratch the agar agar then arrange the small hearts and roses on top. 3 Cool down remaining agar agar liquid a little (not too hot) and gently pour liquid over the small hearts and roses. Leave to set in fridge for few hours or till next day.

Comments:
Sue Woodard

This recipe uses some very unusual ingredients.  Where would I find agar agar and pandan leaf?  I love the look of these, would really like to try them.
Anncoo

Agar agar powder can be found in Asian grocery store but I'm not sure about pandan leaf.
Sue Woodard

Thanks for your quick reply!  I'll go have a look!
